item.title: AI Security
item.description: Yes, I know in this era, everyone focuses on AI security because everyone and their grandma uses AI. Yes, I am not pro-AI. But what about the other areas of security? Binary exploitation, embedded security. All the lower levels that are not the hype right now. Which leads to the question: do people care more about the high-level like software, applications because they’re easier? sexier? or have more attention as the result of more people know about them?
